dial: White with luminous Arabic numerals and markers.
crystal: Sapphire, formed of corundum, 3.5 mm thick. Anti-reflective coating.
movement_note: Hand-wound mechanical, exclusive Panerai OP X calibre, 16½ lignes, 17 jewels, Glucydur® balance, 21,600 alternations/hour. Incabloc® anti-shock device. Swan's neck regulator. Power reserve 56 hours. Côtes de Genève decoration on the bridges.
bracelet: PANERAI personalised leather strap and large size steel buckle. Supplied with a second interchangeable strap and a steel screwdriver.
